children: Strive announced it bought 1,800 bitcoin at an average price of approximately $79,431 per coin and updated cash, holdings, and share counts.
Purchased 1,800 BTC from Aug 24–28, 2026 at an average price of ~$79,431 per bitcoin, inclusive of fees.
Cash and cash equivalents rose to $183.5M from $171.9M as of Aug 28, 2026, a $11.6M increase.
Bitcoin holdings increased to 23,156 coins from 21,356 as of Aug 28, 2026.
Class A shares outstanding rose by 3,579,147 to 83,470,035; assumed fully diluted shares increased to 96,523,351.
